paite: Hiai vualzawlna in ahi Pathian mipa Mosi in asih ma a Israel suante avualzawlna:
heading: Mosi In Israel Namte Avualzawl

paite: "Sinai a pan TOUPA ahong pai a, Seir a pan akiang uah athoukhia a, Paran tang a kipan hong vakkhia in, Mi Siangthou singkhat lak a pan ahong pai; akhut taklam a pan amau a ding in meikuang bang dan a-om.
Ahi, amite a-it a, Mi Siangthou tengteng na khut ah a-om uh. Na khebul ah atu ua; na thute azui chiat ding uh.
Mosi in eite dan ahon pia, Jakob mipite gouluah ding.
"Jeshurun ah amah kumpipa ahi, mipite intekpen leh Israel chi tengteng a-omkhawm lai un.”
"Reuben hing hen, si lou in, amite ahihleh tawm kei uhen."
"Hiai Judah vualzawlna ahi. TOUPA Judah aw ngaikhia inla, amite kiang ah pilut in. Amah a ding in akhut kiching henla, nang amelmate doupihpa hi in."
Levi tungthu ah, "Na Thummim leh na Urim, na misiangthou kiang ah omsak in, Massah ah na ze-et a, Meribah tuite ah na dou hi;
ka nu leh ka pa ka thei kei, chi in; a-unaute leng athei sam kei hi. Amah tate ngei leng athei tuan kei; na thu apom ua, na thukhun azui ngal ua.
Na vaihawmte Jakob asinsak ding ua, Israelte, na dan. Na ma ah gimlim akoih ding ua, na maitam ah halmang thillat.
Aneihte vualzawl in, TOUPA, akhut nasepte ana pom inla; amah doute kawng sat inla, amah hote kawng toh, adin nawnlouhna ding un."
Benjamin tungthu ah zaw, "TOUPA deihtak zaw akiang ah bit in ateng ding. Nitum in amah akhuh dia, aliangte kikal ah ateng ding."
Joseph tungthu ah zaw, "Agam TOUPA vualzawl in om hen, van thil mantam daitui in, tui thuk mahmah nuailam a tui in.
Nisa in apiansak gah manphate leh khapi in a-omsak thil mantamte in.
"Nidanglai tangte athil deihhuaipente in, tangtawn mual a thil mantamte in.
Lei leh atung a thil mantamte in, loubuk a ompa deihsakna in. Vualzawlna Joseph lutung ah hong om hen, a-unaute a pan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah.
Athupina bawngtal piang masa thupina bang ahi a, akiite gam bawngtal kiite bang ahi. Huai in nam chih asi a, kawlmong tan in asi ding. Amaute Ephraim singkhatte ahi ua, Manasseh sangte ahi uhi."
Zebulun tungthu ah, "Kipak in, Zebulun, na vakkhiaknate ah, Issakar, na puaninte ah.
Tang ah chi chih asam ding ua, huai ah diktatna kithoihnate alan ding uh. Tuipi buchinna ne ding ahi ngal ua, piaunel a gou kiselte toh," achi hi.
Gad tungthu ah, "Gad hihlianpa phat in om hen, humpinelkai bang in ateng a, aluzang leh aban ahamkek hi."
"Amah a ding in ahoihna pen atel a, dan pepa tantuan mun a amah atut ziak in, intekpente toh ahoh a, TOUPA vaihawmna dik leh Israelte kiang a vaihawmnate azui hi."
Dan tungthu ah, "Dan zaw humpinelkai nou ahi a, Bashan a pan ahong tawm ding."
Naphtali tungthu ah, "Naphtali aw, deihsakna a lungkim, TOUPA vualzawlna a tai, sim leh tum luah in."
Asher tungthu ah, "Asher tapate a vualzawl in om henla, a-unaute lak ah tuitum henla; thau ah akhete diah hen.
Na khedap sik leh dal ahi dia, na damsung ni bang in na hatna leng a-om ding."
"Jeshurun Pathian nang hon panpih dia van a tuang, thupitak a van a tuang bang kua mahmah a-om kei uhi.
Tangtawn Pathian na kibukna ahi a, nuailam ah atangtawn ban a-om, melmate ahon satmang dia, hihmang in, achi ding hi.
"Israel bel galmuangtak in amah kia in ateng dia, Jakob tui leh buh leh uain gam ah a-om ding, avante'n leng daitui akesak ding uhi.

Na hampha hi, aw, Israel, nangmah bang a TOUPA'N ahotdam mite kua a-om a? Nang hon panpihpa phaw, na thupina namsau ahi! Na melmate nang ah ahong kipe ding ua, nang amun sangte uh na tuanchil ding hi.”
